result.instructions: Tools for Smarty, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Is 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy, Mountain View, CA a deliverable USPS address? Give me the standard form."; "Which ZIP Codes are valid for Provo, Utah?"; "What census tract and block is 1 Rosedale St, Baltimore, MD 21229 in?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Smarty data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run smarty_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run smarty_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run smarty_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. smarty_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: smarty_verify_us_address
tools.title: Verify a US address
tools.description: Check one US address against USPS reference data and return the standardized form, delivery and ZIP+4, and the match and DPV codes. Each call uses one Smarty lookup. Use smarty_reverse_geocode_us for coordinates and smarty_us_address_property for property data.

freeform.description: The whole address in one string, without the country (for example, '1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy, Mountain View, CA').

street.description: The street line, including the house number (for example, '1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy').

secondary.description: The unit: an apartment, suite or floor (for example, 'Apt 4B').

zipcode.description: The 5-digit ZIP Code, or ZIP+4 (for example, '94043').

lastline.description: City, state and ZIP Code as one string, for example 'Mountain View CA 94043'. Use it with street instead of city and state.

match_strategy.description: strict: only deliverable USPS addresses. invalid: also return detail for failed addresses. enhanced (default): the largest dataset, including non-postal addresses such as PMBs.

max_candidates.description: How many candidate matches to return, 1 to 10 (default 1).

tools.name: smarty_lookup_us_zipcode
tools.title: Look up US ZIP Codes
tools.description: Find the valid city, state and ZIP Code combinations for a city and state, or confirm a ZIP Code. Send city with state, or zipcode alone. Each call uses one Smarty lookup.

zipcode.description: The 5-digit ZIP Code, or ZIP+4 (for example, '94043').

tools.name: smarty_reverse_geocode_us
tools.title: Find US addresses near coordinates
tools.description: Find the US street addresses near a latitude and longitude. Returns an empty result when no address is near the point. Each call uses one Smarty lookup.

latitude.description: Latitude as a decimal, from -90 to 90 (for example, 40.2335).

longitude.description: Longitude as a decimal, from -180 to 180. US longitudes are negative (for example, -111.6586).

tools.name: smarty_verify_international_address
tools.title: Verify an international address
tools.description: Check one address outside the US against Smarty's international reference data and return the standardized form and the match status. Each call uses one Smarty lookup. US addresses belong in smarty_verify_us_address.

country.description: The country name or its ISO code (ISO-2, ISO-3 or ISO-N), for example 'Brazil' or 'BR'. Required.

freeform.description: The whole address in one string, without the country. Use it instead of address1 to address2.

address1.description: The first address line (street and number).

address2.description: The second address line, if any.

organization.description: The recipient, firm or company at this address.

administrative_area.description: The state, province or region, as a name or abbreviation.

max_results.description: How many suggestions to return, 1 to 10 (default 1).

tools.name: smarty_us_address_property
tools.title: US property and financial data
tools.description: Return property and financial data for one US address from Smarty's enrichment data (owner and assessment fields, when the plan includes them). Each call uses one Smarty lookup.

freeform.description: The whole address in one string, without the country (for example, '1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy, Mountain View, CA').

street.description: The street line, including the house number (for example, '1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy').

zipcode.description: The 5-digit ZIP Code, or ZIP+4 (for example, '94043').

features.description: Comma-separated dataset names to include. Some need a special plan; the server applies its own default when empty.

tools.name: smarty_us_address_geo_reference
tools.title: US census geography for an address
tools.description: Return the census geographic reference of one US address: tract, block, and FIPS codes. Each call uses one Smarty lookup.

freeform.description: The whole address in one string, without the country (for example, '1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy, Mountain View, CA').

street.description: The street line, including the house number (for example, '1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy').

zipcode.description: The 5-digit ZIP Code, or ZIP+4 (for example, '94043').

features.description: Comma-separated dataset names to include. Some need a special plan; the server applies its own default when empty.

annotations.title: US census geography for an address

tools.name: smarty_us_address_secondary_units
tools.title: List units at a US address
tools.description: List the secondary units (apartments, suites, floors) of one US building address, for example to identify multi-unit buildings. Each call uses one Smarty lookup.

freeform.description: The whole address in one string, without the country (for example, '1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy, Mountain View, CA').

street.description: The street line, including the house number (for example, '1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy').

zipcode.description: The 5-digit ZIP Code, or ZIP+4 (for example, '94043').

features.description: Comma-separated dataset names to include. Some need a special plan; the server applies its own default when empty.

annotations.title: List units at a US address
